cards.title: Read this map
items: Current working-tree architecture, including modified and untracked agent files. Source links refer to a clean local documentation snapshot, not to the remote HEAD.
Application code and original Git history are unchanged. Original HEAD: 2bc16cc634cca62e6153db65833235420ae66305. Snapshot: f60cdc91dff45b8aca880f19db71e2834b8ecc58.
The diagram groups cooperating modules. The companion repo-reference.md inventories every Python module, each registered application endpoint, model contracts, config and operational limits.
Logical call and dependency map, not a measured deployment topology. No inference that configured cloud services are currently reachable.

cards.title: RAG API: policy and operations
items: POST /retrieve: RetrieveRequest → RetrieveResponse. Scoped search, full parent sections, linked amendments, citations and retrieval timings.
POST /answer: RetrieveRequest → AnswerResponse. One retrieval followed by grounded generation and exact quote validation.
POST /answer/evaluated: EvaluatedAnswerRequest → EvaluatedAnswerResponse. Reuses one answer and its exact evidence; returns four quality metric statuses.
GET /health: process liveness only. GET /metrics: process-local retrieval counters. GET /metrics/latency: nearest-rank p50/p95/p99 of the last 1000 successful retrievals.
FastAPI also exposes /docs, /redoc and /openapi.json. Application endpoints return JSON; token streaming is not implemented.

cards.title: Feedback API and review gate
items: POST /feedback → 201 FeedbackRecord; conflicting idempotent submission → 409; unavailable storage → 503.
GET /feedback?limit=20, bounded to 1–100 → list[FeedbackRecord]. Requires FeedbackReviewer bearer credentials.
POST /feedback/{feedback_id}/review: FeedbackReview → status. Requires reviewer credentials and a pending record; absent/already reviewed → 409.
Review uses constant-time token comparison. Missing review configuration → 503; absent/incorrect credentials → 401. Review does not rewrite policy documents or prompts.
Feedback is scoped by institution and stored in MongoDB before optional Datadog thumbs feedback. Submission identity is deterministic from institution, submitter_id and submission_id.

cards.title: Agent API and exact execution order
items: POST /agent: AgentRequest → AgentResponse. Agent Service has its own GET /health and GET /metrics; the RAG application does not register /agent.
Orchestrator → retriever → grounded_answer → END. AgentState retains request, IntentDecision, RetrieveRequest, RetrieveResponse and AgentResponse.
Missing/conflicting scope → needs_clarification. Forbidden takes priority and ends immediately. These routes call neither retrieval nor answer generation.
Customer-context and supported-action routes return unavailable after required-scope checks. No customer read, banking write, Validator or Action stage is connected.
The HTTP adapter calls existing POST /retrieve once. It validates status, strict RetrieveResponse JSON and identical as_of; the answer chain receives retained evidence through RunnableLambda.
HTTP timeout defaults to 60s (maximum 300s), total graph deadline to 180s (maximum 600s), and recursion limit to 8. Redirects are disabled. Upstream failures return a safe generic 503.

cards.title: Retrieval and amendment behavior
items: app/services/retrieval.py wires embeddings, Mongo stores, optional hybrid search, optional reranker and mandatory linked-amendment loading into build_retrieval_chain.
Filters enforce institution, inclusive effective-date range, jurisdiction and confidentiality, plus product when supplied. Jurisdiction falls back to Settings.jurisdiction.
Dense is the default. Hybrid uses Atlas BM25 plus vectors with RRF. Optional reranking broadens candidates before reducing ordinary results to top_k.
Parent sections are validated against child scope; mismatches or missing parents fall back to the matched child. Linked circulars follow supersedes until no new IDs remain.

Full amendments are returned separately from top_k results. Inconsistent amendment scope fails closed. RetrieveResponse.evidence prioritizes complete amendments and removes result duplicates by document/version.
Atlas vector and text indexes are created manually; app/database/indexes.md contains exact definitions. The application does not auto-create search indexes.

cards.title: Grounded answer and model contracts
items: RetrieveRequest: query (1–2000 chars), required as_of, optional product_id/jurisdiction, top_k 1–20 (default 5). All request/response models forbid extra fields.
RetrieveHit: rank, score, matched child text, parent_text and Citation. Citation preserves doc_id, title, policy_version, clause and effective_date.
build_answer_chain packs complete parents or complete children into a token budget. If a full mandatory amendment cannot fit, it returns insufficient_evidence before generation.
AnswerDraft statuses: answered, insufficient_evidence, needs_clarification. Exact nonblank quotes must occur in the supplied context, and inline markers must match evidence IDs.
Quote validation allows at most two drafts with citation feedback. Invalid final evidence returns insufficient_evidence. Source identity is resolved in code into AnswerCitation.matched_child.
AnswerResponse also preserves lookup date, retrieval timings, generation_ms and optional Datadog span ID. AgentResponse wraps it without changing answer statuses.

cards.title: Ingestion and persistence
items: Run python -m app.services.ingestion <document_register.json>. Only authoritative register entries become IngestRequests; ingestion is a CLI, not an HTTP endpoint.
PDF parsing uses pdfplumber; other document formats use unstructured. Clause-aware chunking preserves whole tables and creates stable child and parent IDs.
Text plus metadata, embedding model and dimensions feed checksums. Only changed children are embedded; parents are upserted and stale children/parents removed.

Chunks and embeddings use MONGODB_COLLECTION; unembedded whole parent sections use MONGODB_PARENT_COLLECTION (default policy_sections); feedback uses MONGODB_FEEDBACK_COLLECTION (default policy_feedback).

--retire-doc requires a document no longer authoritative and removes scoped chunks and parents. Cross-collection ingestion has no transaction; the code flags concurrent ingestion as requiring an upgrade.

cards.title: Evaluation, golden data and diagnostics
items: Live scoring: faithfulness, answer_relevancy, context_precision and context_recall. Scores are bounded 0–1, with scored/unavailable/error status per metric.
Context precision/recall require a provided reference or an exact golden match. Faithfulness/relevancy are unavailable for abstentions. Each external metric has a 120s timeout.
python -m app.evaluation.run --dataset evaluation/datasets/answer.jsonl --output <report.json> [--limit N] [--min-score X] runs RAGAS and a structured correctness/groundedness judge.

Offline evaluations capture one retrieval and answer per case plus their exact evidence, traces, timings and model settings. An explicit min-score can fail the quality gate; no default target is invented.
Other evaluation modules provide mechanical quote checks, reranker checks and teaching diagnostics for retrieval, context, parent links, staleness and embedding mismatches.
Golden JSONL stays local. When enabled, scored results join Datadog workflow spans; optional evaluation or telemetry failures preserve the generated answer.

cards.title: Optional reranking dependency
items: RERANK_ENABLED defaults false. app/chains/rerank.py scores query/document pairs through an httpx.AsyncClient with a 60s timeout.
RERANK_API selects native Ollama api/generate or OpenAI-compatible completions. Ranking normalizes finite exact yes/no alternative token log probabilities.
RERANK_BASE_URL defaults http://127.0.0.1:11434 and RERANK_MODEL defaults nexaassist-reranker:0.6b-mlx. These are configured defaults, not proof of a running MLX engine.
Omitted as a separate box because it runs only inside the optional retrieval branch; no new index or alternate vector database is used.

cards.title: Configuration and runtime entry points
items: Python >=3.14, uv, Pydantic v2/pydantic-settings, LangChain LCEL, langchain-mongodb, LangGraph, FastAPI, httpx, Streamlit and ddtrace.
RAG: uv run uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000. Agent: uv run uvicorn app.agent_main:app --port 8001. Port 8001 is an example; AgentSettings only configures the upstream RAG URL.
UI: uv run streamlit run app/streamlit_app.py. UI api_base_url defaults http://127.0.0.1:8000. The UI has no /agent integration.

Settings reads .env; required corpus configuration includes Mongo URI/database/chunk collection, OpenAI API key, institution, jurisdiction and confidentiality. Values of local credentials are not inspected or embedded.
Chat defaults gpt-6-luna; embeddings default text-embedding-3-small/1536 dimensions. These are code defaults, not a statement about environment overrides or provider availability.

cards.title: Observability and deployment
items: app/main.py lifespan initializes optional ddtrace.patch_all, JSON structlog and the token encoder. The Agent Service reuses this lifespan.
LLMObs workflows cover policy answers, agent orchestration and live/offline evaluation; prompt annotations identify prompt version and variables; TokenUsageLogger records provider token usage.
Use ddtrace-run before application creation for APM instrumentation. DD_* process environment configures SDK export; JSON logs being emitted does not itself establish log collection.
app/Dockerfile builds a Python 3.14 RAG API image with the evaluation extra, runs app.main:app and exposes 8000. It does not launch Agent Service or Streamlit.
app/compose.datadog.yaml starts only the Datadog Agent, forwarding host 18126→8126 TCP and 18125→8125 UDP. MongoDB Atlas, OpenAI and the app processes are outside that compose file.

cards.title: Standalone banking mock and future work
items: nexa_synthetic_data/api/mock_server/server.py supplies synthetic customer profile/accounts/transactions/KYC/bureau/income/application reads plus case and service-request writes.
Writes use a bearer caller identity and Idempotency-Key, ETags/If-Match where implemented, and fault injection. The mock accepts any nonempty bearer token; this is not production authentication.
Customers/transactions are loaded from local fixtures; cases, service requests and idempotency records are process-local. There is no durable banking integration.
The mock is deliberately disconnected from the agent in the current code. Validator, Action stage and FastMCP are not implemented. No customer data is copied into this artifact.
